Our web platform has been updated to V6.3.2, which now supports truly passwordless account creation with Google, Apple, or X accounts.

You can also create an account with just a Passkey (now standalone, instead of an alternative authentication option).

teslascope.com/blog/6.3.2

To be mindful of recent supply chain attacks within the developer community, we've also reduced the number of NPM packages used by the platform.

Several dependencies have been replaced with purpose-built implementations. These changes will be felt via performance boosts for all.
Our Membership page was temporarily inaccessible following this update. This has now been resolved and all impacted members have been directly contacted.

Signing in with X has been broken since December 2025; this has now been resolved. This now allows you to create an account and sign in solely with an X Account! 🎉

As with all OAuth providers (Google, Apple, X), we strongly encourage using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).

As far as we know, Teslascope is one of the only third-party Tesla apps with native support for Passkeys and has for over a year now.

We encourage all other apps to provide this experience for vehicle owners. 🔐

We just added automated rollout detection to our platform, which will monitor all software updates released in the last 30 days.

The post will include the percentage increase and list all models included in the wave, such as "Model Y AI4".

To clarify, this enables automated posts here on X, just like our software update posts.

We'll be adding a dedicated section for this to our web platform this week, and our iOS app will support receiving rollout notifications before month end.
